clips.label: Power-On Sequence
clips.desc: Boot flicker, power-core charge, cooling fan and hydraulic pump spin-up, servo self-test.

clips.label: Mechanical Startup
clips.desc: Abduction calibration, synchronized stand-up from crouch and arm deployment from stowed.

clips.label: Idle
clips.desc: Seamless loop: suspension breathing, turret scanning, wrist micro-motions.

clips.label: Joint Demonstration
clips.desc: Every actuator exercised in isolation: leg abduction, hip, knee, turret, shoulder, elbow, wrist and gripper, then body posture.

clips.label: Walking Cycle
clips.desc: Diagonal trot with planted feet, acceleration lean and inertial arm lag.

clips.label: Arm Manipulation
clips.desc: Inverse-kinematics workspace sweep through five waypoints with wrist roll and gripper cycles.

clips.label: Object Interaction
clips.desc: Pick a 2 kg sample crate from the work stand and stow it on the cargo deck; suspension reacts to the payload.

clips.label: Full Operating Mode
clips.desc: Autonomous patrol: trotting at 0.5 m/s while the arm scans and the lidar maps at double rate.

clips.label: Shutdown Sequence
clips.desc: Arm stows, body parks on the skid plate, rotating machinery spins down, power fades.

clips.label: Exploded View
clips.desc: Every component separates along its assembly axis, holds, and re-assembles.
